title: Left wheel stuck or jammed
shortDescription: The left drive wheel is jammed by debris, hair, or carpet fibers.
fullDescription:
Eufy RoboVac signals Error 1 when the left drive wheel motor encounters excessive resistance or fails to rotate. The robot stops in place and announces a wheel error.

Most commonly the cause is hair, string, or carpet fringe wound around the axle, but it can also indicate a high-pile rug the wheel cannot climb or a faulty wheel encoder.

causes.cause: Hair or string wound around left wheel axle
Wheel stuck on rug fringe or threshold

fixSteps.title: Flip robot over
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, turn the robot upside down on a flat surface.

fixSteps.title: Inspect left wheel
fixSteps.instruction: Push wheel up and down — it should compress and rotate freely. Remove any visible debris.

fixSteps.title: Cut away tangled hair
fixSteps.instruction: Use scissors to carefully cut hair wrapped at the axle, then pull it free with tweezers.

whenToCallPro: If the wheel still does not spin freely after cleaning, the motor or encoder may be defective and require service.

faq.q: Why does Error 1 keep coming back?
faq.a: Carpet fringe and pet hair can repeatedly tangle the wheel — clean weekly to prevent it.

title: Right wheel stuck or jammed
shortDescription: The right drive wheel will not rotate, usually from debris.
fullDescription:
Error 2 is the mirror of Error 1 — the right wheel motor is drawing too much current or not turning. The robot halts and prompts for service.

Check for tangled hair, foreign objects, or that the wheel suspension is moving freely up and down.

fixSteps.title: Power off and flip
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off main switch and place robot upside down.

fixSteps.title: Clean wheel
fixSteps.instruction: Cut and remove any hair or threads at the right wheel axle.

fixSteps.title: Test suspension
fixSteps.instruction: Press the wheel up — it should spring back. If not, lubricate suspension.

whenToCallPro: If the wheel motor is silent or hot to the touch.
videoSearchQuery: Eufy RoboVac error 2 right wheel fix

faq.q: Can I replace just the wheel?
faq.a: Yes, replacement wheel modules are sold for most RoboVac models for about $25-40.

title: Side brush jammed
shortDescription: A side brush is tangled or seized.
fullDescription:
Error 3 fires when a side brush motor stalls. Hair, string, and carpet fibers commonly wrap around the side brush post and bind the motor.

Removing the brush and clearing the post normally resolves the issue.

fixSteps.title: Unscrew side brush
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the screw on top of the side brush and lift it off.

fixSteps.title: Clear hair under post
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and cut all wrapped hair from the brush spindle.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed — replace side brush if bent.
videoSearchQuery: Eufy RoboVac error 3 side brush fix

faq.q: How often should I clean side brushes?
faq.a: Every 1-2 weeks in homes with pets or long hair.

title: Main brush stuck
shortDescription: Main rolling brush will not rotate.
fullDescription:
Error 4 indicates the main brush motor is overloaded. Hair and threads commonly wrap around the brush bearings on either end.

Remove the brush guard and bristle bar to clear the obstruction.

fixSteps.title: Remove brush guard
fixSteps.instruction: Press the tabs and lift the brush guard off the underside.

fixSteps.title: Pull brush and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Lift brush out, remove end caps, cut tangled hair.

whenToCallPro: If brush motor is silent after cleaning.
videoSearchQuery: Eufy RoboVac error 4 main brush fix

title: Front bumper stuck
shortDescription: The front bumper is depressed or jammed.
fullDescription:
Eufy uses a spring-loaded front bumper to detect collisions. If the bumper does not return to its rest position the robot reports Error 5 and refuses to drive.

Dust can build up between the bumper and chassis preventing free movement.
symptoms: Bumper does not click when pressed

fixSteps.title: Tap bumper
fixSteps.instruction: Firmly tap the bumper several times to dislodge debris.

fixSteps.title: Blow out gaps
fixSteps.instruction: Use compressed air around the bumper edges.

videoSearchQuery: Eufy RoboVac error 5 bumper stuck fix

faq.q: Why does my bumper stick on hardwood?
faq.a: Dust accumulates faster on hard floors — clean weekly.

title: Cliff sensor error
shortDescription: Cliff sensors are dirty or detect a drop continuously.
fullDescription:
Cliff sensors on the underside use infrared to detect stairs. If lenses are dirty or the floor is very dark/reflective, the robot may report a false cliff reading and stop.

Wiping the four sensor windows usually clears the error.
symptoms: False cliff warnings on dark rugs

fixSteps.title: Wipe sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Flip robot, wipe each cliff sensor with a dry microfiber.

whenToCallPro: If error persists on light flooring after cleaning.

faq.q: Why does my robot avoid black rugs?
faq.a: IR cliff sensors interpret black as a drop — use no-go zones in the app.

title: Battery low / not detected
shortDescription: Battery is critically low or not communicating.
fullDescription:
Error 7 means battery voltage is too low to operate or the battery management chip is not responding. After 1-2 years of daily use, capacity often falls below threshold.

Reseat or replace the battery; if a new pack does not resolve the error, the charging contacts or main board are suspect.

fixSteps.title: Remove and reseat battery
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew battery cover, unplug and replug battery.

fixSteps.title: Clean dock contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe metal contacts on dock and robot with alcohol.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Install genuine Eufy replacement battery.

whenToCallPro: If a new battery still fails to charge — likely main board.

faq.q: How long do RoboVac batteries last?

title: Charging error
shortDescription: Robot fails to charge on dock.
fullDescription:
When docked, the robot expects a steady 19-20V supply. Error 8 indicates the supply is missing, inconsistent, or the contacts are dirty.

Clean the four contact strips on the dock and underside of the robot.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe both dock and robot contacts with alcohol pads.

fixSteps.title: Test adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Verify dock LED is solid green when plugged in.

whenToCallPro: If both adapter and battery test good.

faq.q: Should the dock LED stay on?
faq.a: Yes — solid green when ready, off if no power.

title: Dust bin full or missing
shortDescription: Dust collection bin is full, missing, or sensor fault.
fullDescription:
RoboVac monitors bin presence with a microswitch. If the bin is missing, not fully seated, or sensors detect over-fill, Error 10 will halt the run.

Empty the bin, wipe the IR window, and ensure the bin clicks fully into place.

fixSteps.title: Empty bin
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out bin, empty into trash, tap out filter.

fixSteps.title: Wash filter
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse foam pre-filter; HEPA filter dry-tap only. Air dry 24h.

title: LiDAR sensor blocked
shortDescription: Top LiDAR turret is obstructed or fails to spin.
fullDescription:
Newer Eufy models with mapping use a spinning LiDAR turret. Error 11 means the turret is blocked, dirty, or its motor is faulty.

Clear any furniture above the robot, clean the turret window, and confirm it spins freely when powered.

causes.cause: Furniture pinning robot under low clearance

fixSteps.title: Move robot to open area
fixSteps.instruction: Place in clear room and reboot.

fixSteps.title: Clean LiDAR
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe turret window and remove any hair at base.

whenToCallPro: If LiDAR motor does not spin after cleaning.

faq.q: Can I clean LiDAR with alcohol?
faq.a: Use a dry microfiber only — alcohol can damage the optical window coating.
